title: SourceRegistry
description: The provenance registry. Every source of truth, recorded once, with who can produce it on request.

kind.description: repo-file = a path inside one of the two repos, checked on disk by C6. repo-git = a git object (`git show <ref>:<path>`), used when the working tree no longer holds the file. owner-archive = a directory on the owner's machine, OUTSIDE both repos; CI cannot reach it, so C6 warns and never fails.

custodian.description: Who can produce this on request. 'public' when anyone can open it.

trust.description: primary = an institution, an immutable artifact, or a direct query against the system of record. self-reported = Duy said it (legitimate; just labelled). derived = computed from other sources by a script.
